instructions.en: Run `docker system prune -a` while Colima is running, or `colima delete` to remove an instance entirely.
instructions.nb: Kjør `docker system prune -a` mens Colima kjører, eller `colima delete` for å fjerne en instans helt.

summary.en: Virtual machine disks holding all containers and images for Colima instances.
summary.nb: VM-disker som holder alle containere og images for Colima-instanser.
